rows.details: A Novel Two-in-One Orthobiologic Injectable for Treating Bone Infections and Defects
Three years or up to the termination of project
Must not be more than 30 years as on closing date of application

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess a Master’s or PhD Degree in Materials Science, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Lifesciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, or other medical or life science related subjects. Applications are accepted with or without qualifying exams such as GATE, NET, or CSIR-UGC. An ideal candidate should have: Working knowledge of human anatomy and physiology Hands on experience in a wet-lab environment Proficiency in materials formulations & chemistry Ability to design and execute biochemical and physical testing protocols Biomedical translational and collaborative acumen Prior clinical interactions or industry experience (preferable)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- plus 10% HRA per month as per ICMR norms. The appointment is for a duration of three years or up to the termination of the project, subject to annual performance review. Candidates may also be considered for alternative opportunities based on their performance on the project.

content_sections.heading: IIT Ropar Project Research Scientist I Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected Project Research Scientist I will work on a high-impact ICMR-funded project involving IIT Ropar and PGIMER Chandigarh titled “A Novel Two-in-One Orthobiologic Injectable for Treating Bone Infections and Defects”. The role involves materials formulations, chemistry, designing and executing biochemical and physical testing protocols, and working in a wet-lab environment.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview, which may be held in person or online. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview if it is conducted in person.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist – I post?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist – I position.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Applicants must hold a Master’s or PhD Degree in Materials Science, Biochemistry, Biophysics, Lifesciences, Biotechnology, Biomedical Engineering, Pharmacy, or other medical or life science related subjects.

faq.question: Q4. Is a GATE or NET score mandatory to apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates can apply with or without qualifying exams like GATE, NET, or CSIR-UGC.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 30 years old as on the closing date of application, with age relaxation applicable as per GOI norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The approved salary is Rs. 56,000/- plus 10% HRA per month as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q7. How should candidates submit their application?
faq.answer: Candidates must email the completed application form attached to the advertisement along with their CV to Dr. Atharva Poundarik at [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the position?
faq.answer: Candidates will be selected through a shortlisting process followed by an interview, which can be conducted either in person or online.

faq.question: Q9. Are allowances paid in addition to the base salary?
faq.answer: Yes, 10% HRA per month is paid in addition to the base salary of Rs. 56,000/- as per ICMR norms.

faq.question: Q10. What documents or details are needed for the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the duly completed application form along with their candidate CV via email.
